name: Holiday Inn Express (Herriman, UT) Toasted Plain Bagel with Philadelphia Cream Cheese
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Herriman - South Jordan
whyItWorks: Plain wheat bagel toasted warm and spread with smooth pasteurized cream cheese. Seedless, low-fat, and filling for road trips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast a plain bagel in the rotary hotel toaster; spread lightly with cream cheese (pass on everything bagels with sesame and poppy seeds).
watchOuts: Avoid everything bagels containing abrasive sesame and poppy seeds
